mapper.select: /** * searchComboBoxAprv : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.OfwkUpcsdClngMapper : 승인상태구분코드 조회 */ SELECT AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS CD_VALUE , AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CD_NAME FROM SAC100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'APRV_STTS_SE_CD' AND AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN ('0','2','5')
mapper.insert: /* * insertOfwkUpcsdClngBatch : isry.couns.mngr.workaltmntmng.mapper.OfwkUpcsdClngMapper : 퇴근미처리소명일괄생성 * 2023.06.28 수정 - Jeong.Won.Je */ INSERT INTO AYC310 ( USER_ID , UNOF_YMD , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT ) WITH INQ_TB AS ( SELECT T1.WORK_YMD AS WORK_YMD , T1.CONSTT_ID AS USER_ID , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AYC310 T2 WHERE 1=1 AND T2.USER_ID = T1.CONSTT_ID AND T2.UNOF_YMD = T1.WORK_YMD AND T2.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS CNT FROM AYC495 T1 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.WORK_YMD BETWEEN #{fromWorkYmd} AND #{toWorkYmd} AND T1.LVFFC_DT IS NULL ) SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT USER_ID , WORK_YMD , #{loginId} , SYSDATE , #{loginId} , SYSDATE FROM INQ_TB WHERE 1=1 AND CNT = 0 ) T
